notes.title: 4-PACKS (and other discounts)
notes.content:
[b][u]4-PACKS[/u][/b]

A 4-Pack for Wanderlust Adventures has been made on the Humble Store.
 - [i]Wanderlust Adventures is Steam-Only, so our Humble store page only sells Steam Keys.[/i]

It's the least we can do for you guys! We really wanted to do one with Steam directly but they have informed us that there are no plans to support a 4-Pack for Wanderlust Adventures.

[b][u]UPCOMING DISCOUNTS[/u][/b]

We'd like to take this opportunity to assure everyone that there are no plans to discount Wanderlust Adventures for at least [u]4 months following the launch[/u] of the game. 

Those of you who are "on the fence" or perhaps "waiting for a sale" can now - hopefully - make a more informed decision about whether or not you should wait to purchase the game.

Of course, we believe the time is NOW! <3

[b][u]THANK YOU[/u][/b]

We would like to thank everyone who has supported us through this Whirlwind (#WarriorHype) of a launch period for us! Nothing has gone according to plan but we're doing the best we can!

<3 Yeti Trunk & Chucklefish

notes.title: Boss Fight: Peek At Wanderlust Adventures Enemies
notes.content:
Ah wanderlust, that sweet call to adventure. It’s what drove Kerouak to meander America and Chris McCandless to shake off his dreary middle-class roots. I experienced wanderlust last night myself, when suddenly I was overtaken by the desire to experience something true and real and powerful like a kebab. So overtaken with the desire to reject my phony, humdrum existence without this, my meaty and spiritual totem, that I began an intense four-minute walk to the kebab shop: A story I will impart to my children, and they to their children, for generations. For, as I will say to them wisely, why live without kebabs when you can instead eat a kebab and become one with it?

And with that comes the tenuously linked albeit beautifully wanderful Wanderlust Adventures [official site]. We mentioned it to you just last month: published by the guys behind Starbound, it’s an exploration-heavy with four-player online co-op, all very true to Chucklefish style – free-roaming, randomised dungeons, gerbils.

… [visit site to read more]
